# ADR-NNNN: <decision, in a short sentence>

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Status | Proposed \| Accepted \| Rejected \| Deprecated \| Superseded by ADR-XXXX |
| Date | YYYY-MM-DD |
| Deciders | {{OWNER}} (accepts), architect (proposes) |
| Related requirements | REQ-... |
| Supersedes | ADR-... or none |

## Context

What problem or force makes a decision necessary now. Facts, constraints,
requirements and numbers; no solution yet.

## Decision

What we will do, stated plainly and actively ("We will ...").

## Options considered

| Option | Pros | Cons |
|---|---|---|
| A (chosen) | | |
| B | | |
| C | | |

## Consequences

- Positive: ...
- Negative, and how we live with it: ...
- What would make us revisit this decision (a measurable trigger): ...

## Compliance

How a reviewer or a test can check that the code follows this decision
(for example: "every tenant table has an RLS policy, checked by
`tests/db/test_rls_policies.py`").
